DLSSExperimentalRuntimeConfig.description: Selects the backend, exact runtime files, host platform, Proton installation and Worker lifecycle. Windows launches natively; Linux uses Proton. Native Linux NR and the official adapter are not implemented.

backend.name: NR backend
backend.tooltip: auto reads the preset backend. direct_nr is active; the official adapter is reserved.

proton.name: Installed Proton
proton.tooltip: Linux/Proton only. A custom Proton path takes precedence.

linux_display_backend.name: Linux display backend
linux_display_backend.tooltip: Auto selects Xwayland, including on Wayland desktops. Direct NR currently rejects native Wayland.

worker_policy.name: Legacy worker policy
worker_policy.tooltip: Legacy policy; the resident toggle takes precedence. auto means isolated.

runtime_preset.name: Runtime preset path
runtime_preset.tooltip: Absolute path or relative to the node's user data directory; not relative to the repository.

catalog.name: Runtime catalog
catalog.tooltip: Optional output from Runtime Probe. Execution still checks the actual host.

keep_worker_alive.name: Lazy resident Worker
keep_worker_alive.tooltip: On: lazily reuse matching dimensions/NR controls. Off: release after task. NR control changes rebuild the instance.

idle_timeout_seconds.name: Idle release timeout (s)
idle_timeout_seconds.tooltip: Automatically release an idle resident after this many seconds; manual release is also available.

system_platform.name: Host platform
system_platform.tooltip: auto uses the Comfy backend host, not the browser. An explicit choice must match the host.

linux_execution.name: Linux execution mode
linux_execution.tooltip: Proton is implemented. native_reserved is a placeholder and fails explicitly.

proton_path.name: Custom Proton path
proton_path.tooltip: Absolute Proton directory or launcher path; supports ~. Blank uses the dropdown. No shell arguments.

DLSSExperimentalTemporalSettings.description: Connect DIS or NVIDIA optical flow. Controls analysis size, scene-cut resets and consistency diagnostics. Without a provider, uses legacy DIS/zero mode. Computes only requested ranges.

analysis_scale.name: Flow analysis size (percent)
analysis_scale.tooltip: Percent of working-frame dimensions used for flow analysis; vectors are scaled back to NR pixel units.

scene_cut_threshold.name: Scene-cut threshold
scene_cut_threshold.tooltip: Scene-change detection threshold for resetting motion/NR history, not effect intensity.

consistency_tolerance.name: Consistency tolerance (px)
consistency_tolerance.tooltip: Forward/backward consistency tolerance in pixels; diagnostic only, not model strength.

motion_provider.name: Fallback motion mode
motion_provider.tooltip: Used only without a connected provider. Zero motion still retains NR history and cut detection.

flow_provider.name: Optical-flow provider
flow_provider.tooltip: Connected DIS/NVIDIA provider takes precedence over fallback motion mode.

DLSSExperimentalPrepareTemporalSequence.description: Inspect video information and compatibility without running NR. Missing SDR tags require explicit interpretation. Optional sRGB pixel conversion is cached during processing; final decoding checks cover the requested range.

video.name: Video
video.tooltip: Input VIDEO, preserving upstream trims/crops. No whole-video NR is run here.

color_policy.name: Color metadata policy
color_policy.tooltip: Strict requires known tags. Fill missing only applies assumptions to absent tags; never overrides known HDR.

assumed_transfer.name: Assumed missing transfer
assumed_transfer.tooltip: Used only for missing transfer tags. iec61966-2-1 means sRGB.

assumed_range.name: Assumed missing range
assumed_range.tooltip: Missing range only: tv = limited, pc = full. Does not modify the source file.

normalize_to_srgb.name: Normalize to sRGB (SDR)
normalize_to_srgb.tooltip: Converts supported BT.709 SDR pixels to sRGB before flow/NR and back for matched A/B export. Cached independently of Look. Already-sRGB is unchanged. Not HDR conversion.

ffmpeg_path.name: FFmpeg path (optional)
ffmpeg_path.tooltip: Absolute host executable or bin directory. Blank uses the Comfy backend PATH. No quotes or arguments; not a Proton path. Only this DLSS input branch is affected.

ffprobe_path.name: ffprobe path (optional)
ffprobe_path.tooltip: Absolute executable or bin directory. Blank uses the explicit FFmpeg directory; otherwise backend PATH. Invalid explicit paths never fall back. Check input shows the resolved tools.

DLSSExperimentalNRProfile.description: Shared NR Look for Preview and Process. Preset/style meanings depend on the Worker/model; these are not SR quality modes. Render again after edits. Mix is post-render blending; external depth/mask planes are not transmitted.

nr_enabled.name: Enable NR
nr_enabled.tooltip: Disable for a true bypass; the Worker is skipped.

intensity.name: NR intensity
intensity.tooltip: Model enhancement strength, not mix. Zero intensity is not a guaranteed bypass; disable NR or set mix to zero.

mix.name: Result blend
mix.tooltip: Post-render input/result blend. Zero returns input and skips the Worker; one uses full NR output. Not a model parameter.

nr_preset.name: Model preset (experimental)
nr_preset.tooltip: Model default recommended. Experimental A/B/C had identical output on the tested pair; not SR quality/balanced modes.

nr_style.name: Style
nr_style.tooltip: Community labels, not guaranteed across DLLs. Natural is the legacy default. Render again after changing.

local_tone_strength.name: Local tone
local_tone_strength.tooltip: Local tone strength passed to NR, not a browser color filter.

local_structure_strength.name: Structure and detail
local_structure_strength.tooltip: NR structure/detail control; excessive values can alter details.

skin_structure_strength.name: Skin structure (-1 = auto)
skin_structure_strength.tooltip: -1 retains runtime defaults. No extra skin-sharpening pass or external skin mask; response depends on the model/input.

automatic_mask.name: Automatic mask
automatic_mask.tooltip: Requests runtime automatic masking; not an external mask input or a guarantee of visible change.

ui_correction.name: UI correction (experimental)
ui_correction.tooltip: Experimental. No separate UI texture is provided; leave off for ordinary video. Burned-in subtitles are not guaranteed protected.

worker_profile.name: Worker profile (experimental)
worker_profile.tooltip: Keep the compatible profile unless testing the Worker. Not image-quality levels; no response observed on the tested pair.

DLSSExperimentalRuntimeProbe.description: Detects the host, NVIDIA driver, video tools and installed Proton versions without loading external DLLs.

include_diagnostics.name: Include diagnostics
include_diagnostics.tooltip: Include additional host/tool diagnostics; no DLLs are loaded.

DLSSExperimentalDISFlow.description: Lazy CPU optical flow; connect to Video Guides. Quality uses finer DIS analysis, not a learned model.

preset.name: Compute preset
preset.tooltip: Balances CPU cost and DIS analysis quality; only runs for requested ranges.

DLSSExperimentalNVIDIAFlow.description: Native NVIDIA hardware optical flow; never silently falls back to DIS. Requires the host helper and driver, not Proton or model weights. Linux GPU-tested; Windows GPU validation is pending.

preset.name: Compute preset
preset.tooltip: Hardware optical-flow performance/quality preset; not NR intensity.

output_grid.name: Output grid
output_grid.tooltip: Smaller grid produces denser output, not guaranteed better NR. Unsupported choices fail explicitly.

temporal_hints.name: Reuse temporal hints
temporal_hints.tooltip: Resets on cuts and new requests. Forward/backward estimates keep separate histories.

device.name: CUDA device index
device.tooltip: Native CUDA device ordinal used by the optical-flow helper.

DLSSExperimentalPreviewSession.description: Creates in-node A/B previews and VIDEO outputs. Saving video_b/video_a retains this preview's range, single-frame mode and scale; it does not automatically export the full-resolution whole video. Use Process Video → Save Video for independent final output.

sequence.name: Prepared video input
sequence.tooltip: Input Adapter sequence: VIDEO, color interpretation and motion settings.

runtime.name: Runtime configuration
runtime.tooltip: Selects runtime files, host/Proton and Worker lifecycle.

profile_b.name: Current Look B
profile_b.tooltip: Look being adjusted. video_b contains its preview result.

profile_a.name: Reference Look A (optional)
profile_a.tooltip: Optional second Look. Unconnected means original at matching size/color. Adds an NR pass; does not freeze the Look.

start_time.name: Preview start (s)
start_time.tooltip: Seconds from the input VIDEO start, after any upstream trim.

duration.name: Manual duration (s)
duration.tooltip: Ignored by Process to end. Otherwise range length, clamped at input end; in frame mode only bounds the cursor. Not end time, batch size or warmup.

preview_scale.name: Preview dimensions (percent)
preview_scale.tooltip: Scales both dimensions: 50 means about one quarter the pixels, 100 means input size. Changes NR input and VIDEO output, not just display. Not SR.

contract.name: History settings (optional)
contract.tooltip: History processing only. Default context 0.5 s and new-Worker warmup 120 evaluations; neither adds to output duration.

preview_mode.name: Queue preview mode
preview_mode.tooltip: Main Comfy Run uses this mode. The two card buttons select frame/range for one request without changing saved values or running downstream saves.

cursor_time.name: Cursor offset within range (s)
cursor_time.tooltip: Offset within the selected range; start 10 plus cursor 1.5 selects around 11.5 s. Frame mode only; range mode ignores it.

process_to_end.name: Process to video end
process_to_end.tooltip: Reads remaining duration automatically; start 0 means whole video. The frame button still outputs one frame. Frame/disk capacity checks remain.

DLSSExperimentalCompareVideo.description: Reserved comparison-video exporter; not implemented. Use Preview Session for browser-only wipe, side-by-side, flicker and difference.

mode.name: Comparison mode
mode.tooltip: Reserved export layout, not an active render setting.

split_percent.name: Split position (percent)
split_percent.tooltip: Reserved split position; comparison export is not implemented.

DLSSExperimentalRenderContract.description: Internal temporal processing, not output duration. Warmup and preceding context assist NR and are not saved. Set output range in Preview/Process. Processing is continuous, not duration-sized batches.

warmup_frames.name: New Worker warmup evaluations
warmup_frames.tooltip: Repeated first-frame NR evaluations for a new Worker, not output frames/batch size. Compatible residents reuse initialization.

pre_roll.name: Preceding history (s, not output)
pre_roll.tooltip: Real context before output start for motion/NR history. Not saved, and cannot cross the upstream trim start.

DLSSExperimentalProcessVideo.description: Controls final output independently of Preview and produces VIDEO for Save Video. Process to end resolves remaining input duration. Preparation is disk-backed with frame-count and free-space checks; there is no fixed 30-second truncation.

sequence.name: Prepared video input
sequence.tooltip: Input Adapter sequence: VIDEO, color interpretation and motion settings.

runtime.name: Runtime configuration
runtime.tooltip: Selects runtime files, host/Proton and Worker lifecycle.

profile.name: NR Look
profile.tooltip: Look for final output; can be shared with Preview.

start_time.name: Output start (s)
start_time.tooltip: Seconds from input VIDEO start, independent of Preview.

duration.name: Output duration (s, 0 = remainder)
duration.tooltip: Ignored by Process to end. Otherwise positive duration or legacy zero for all remaining input. Requires sufficient disk.

scale.name: Output dimensions (percent)
scale.tooltip: 100 preserves input dimensions; 50/75 downscale width and height. Independent of Preview; not DLSS upscaling.

contract.name: History settings (optional)
contract.tooltip: Internal history only; start, duration and Process to end determine final output range.

process_to_end.name: Process to video end
process_to_end.tooltip: Output from start to input end, ignoring manual duration. Start 0 and scale 100 give the whole input at its original size.

DLSSExperimentalCarrierTest.description: Optional ReShade/RenoDX/D3D12 carrier diagnostic. It does not render NR frames and is not required for direct NR.

runtime.name: Runtime configuration
runtime.tooltip: Requires a ReShade diagnostic preset, not the direct NR video preset.

present_count.name: Diagnostic present count
present_count.tooltip: Number of diagnostic swapchain presents; not NR output frames.
